variety_description: Pusa Basmati 1718—a MAS derived and improved version of iconic Pusa 1121. Developed by IARI, Delhi and released in 2017 for the states of Punjab, UP, Haryana and Uttarakhand (Basmati growing regions). Medium maturity, relatively tall variety with good yield potential. Exhibits resistance to major pests and diseases. It has extra-long slender grains (8.1 mm), high kernel length after cooking (17mm) and strong aroma which are desirable traits for export of Basmati rice.
